verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce and billing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence presents Lemon Squeezy only as a hosted merchant-of-record service that handles payments for you, and nothing shows a self-hostable or open-source core. The offboarding complaints show lock-in rather than any self-host option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
